reference.description: re-computes the permutation entropy per channel with the canonical Python antropy.perm_entropy (order 3, delay 1) and compares to eegComplexity's; reports max |diff| (< 1e-9, machine precision), mean |diff|, the correlation (1.0), both engines' mean entropy (~0.908), and the channel count (64)
